donnees.titre_officiel: Angiographie Gezielte MIGS Chirurgie: Translationales Pilotprojekt
donnees.raison_arret: insufficient effect size at planned interim analysis
donnees.resume_source: MIGS procedures are currently performed without targeting a specific region of the outflow pathway. The temporal surgical approach means that treatment is delivered to the nasal quadrant. Preclinical analyses have shown that targeted treatment of low-flow regions of the trabecular meshwork can improve efficacy. The aim of this study is to use aqueous angiography to guide the placement of an established MIGS procedure, excimer laser trabeculostomy (ELT; Elios Vision GmbH), in order to improve its efficacy.

eligibilite.criteres:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age equal to or above 45 years
* written informed consent
* Cataract with indication for surgery
* preperimetric to moderate open-angle glaucoma
* central corneal thickness 480-620µm
* availability, willingness and ability to understand and give consent to study participation

Exclusion Criteria:

* participation in another interventional study
* previous glaucoma surgery
* previous selective laser trabeculoplasty
* ambiguous glaucoma diagnosis
* ocular hypertension
* corneal pathology with influence on intraocular pressure measurement
* inflammatory ocular disease
* increases risk for intraoperative floppy iris syndrome
* medical interventions planned in parallel, that interfere with the study intervention
